name: minimax-h3-replica
purpose: Run a lightweight source-faithful MiniMax H3 Ref2VA replication lane when the user explicitly selects MiniMax H3.
output_contract: The route activates only for an explicit MiniMax H3 replication request.
ElevenLabs word timestamps control speech timing and FFmpeg measured cuts control visual timing.
Timelines, cuts, transcripts, and boundaries are reusable only when their recorded source hash matches the current source bytes.
Every source interval maps to exactly one ordered H3 Shot and one unit of at most 15 seconds.
Every prompt follows the six-section Ref2VA structure and uses an audio marker matching the real mix intent.

Changed speech cannot pass pre-generation QC without one full VoxCPM2 master per unit, generation provenance, matching prompt and upload hashes, deterministic postmix policy, and direct user listening approval.
Every paid unit creates at most one Task Key, preserves its request and raw output, and receives no automatic retry.
Exact-delivery audio remains bound to the approved master rather than an unverified H3 waveform-copy claim.
exclusions: Does not replace the generic viral-replica route when MiniMax H3 is not named.
Does not require storyboard image editing, depth references, or Seedance handoff artifacts.
Does not treat a Wujie create response or generic query error as a successful or failed MiniMax generation outcome.
rollback_boundary: The Skill, prompt standard, request standard, and public wrapper may be reverted without deleting existing Job timelines, approved audio masters, Task Keys, requests, raw outputs, or accepted videos.
